SEP 10, 2026
v0.1.0 · PREVIEW

The first hit

getEQd arrives with a six-band response curve tuned for real listening: sub-kick control, low-mid cleanup, presence shaping, and a gentle air shelf. The console now supports Reference, Impact, Dialogue, and Night profiles.

Room-aware, not room-blind

Microphone-assisted calibration is in the lab. The goal is a correction curve you can understand, audition, and undo—not a mystery button that changes everything.

THE RULE

Trust your ears
